query: Please implement a bank payment automation system for handling payment transactions. The system should have functionalities for payment application, payment confirmation, and payment result inquiry. Users should be able to log in, submit payment applications, view payment results, and query historical payment records. Apply bisque to the canvas background and dark salmon to all visible components.
